ams-mode0.description: BYPASS / unity. Stops the generator and restores all 12 mixer gains to 1.0 over 20 ms. This is NOT mute.

ams-bypass.description: BYPASS / unity. Stops the generator and restores all 12 mixer gains to 1.0 over 20 ms. This is NOT mute.

ams-mode1.description: AUTO. Starts the 12 cycles. Repeating start or mode 1 while already running does not reset their phases.

ams-start.description: AUTO. Starts the 12 cycles. Repeating start or mode 1 while already running does not reset their phases.

ams-mode2.description: STOP / mute. Stops the generator and fades all 12 mixer gains to 0.0 over 20 ms. This is NOT bypass.

ams-stop.description: STOP / mute. Stops the generator and fades all 12 mixer gains to 0.0 over 20 ms. This is NOT bypass.

ams-restart.description: RESTART. Engages Auto and begins all cycles again from 0.0. Use after parameter edits to apply new cycle settings now.

ams-bang.description: RESTART. Engages Auto and begins all cycles again from 0.0. Use after parameter edits to apply new cycle settings now.

ams-range.description: Set one-leg bounds: 2000 to 10000 ms, independently chosen per voice per cycle.

ams-range-equal.description: Equal bounds give exactly 3000 ms for each rising and falling leg of future cycles.

ams-wait.description: Hold at zero for 5000 ms after each falling leg.

ams-wait-zero.description: No hold at zero; each voice starts its next cycle immediately after falling.

ams-peak-one.description: Every new cycle peaks at 1.0. Values still ramp continuously between 0.0 and 1.0.

ams-peak-random.description: Restore independent random peak targets between 0.0 and 1.0 for new cycles.

ams-grain.description: Default 20 ms float-update interval and Auto signal interpolation time.

ams-grain-slow.description: 100 ms float updates and Auto signal interpolation; does not change the cycle-duration settings.

ams-recipe-slow.description: SLOW RANDOM MIX: independent 2-10 s rises and falls, then 5 s at zero. Full cycles: 9-25 s; random peak levels.

ams-recipe-continuous.description: CONTINUOUS FULL PEAKS: independent 0.75-2.5 s legs, no hold. Full cycles: 1.5-5 s; every peak target is 1.0.

ams-recipe-synchronous.description: SYNCHRONIZED CYCLES: all 12 rise for 2 s, fall for 2 s, then wait 1 s. The fixed duration and common restart align their 5 s cycles.
